name: std-app-layout
description: std-app-layout — dashboard-layout chrome (sidebar nav + top bar with search + topBarActions + notifications) wrapping a single contentTrait slot. Use for list-style apps (CMS / helpdesk / CRM) and account/settings pages: the chrome stays stable while the consumer's content trait renders the data, and the consumer can add domain icons (cart / profile / help) via topBarActions. Bind once per orbital — the consumer rebinds linkedEntity via `XAppLayout = AppShell.traits.AppLayout -> XEntity` so multiple orbitals in one file each get their own chrome without colliding on a shared atom entity.

appName.description: Name shown in the top-left of the chrome header.
appName.label: What should this app be called?
appName.synonyms: app title, product name, brand name, application name, site name

contentClassName.description: CSS class applied to the content area wrapper.
contentClassName.label: Content wrapper class

contentTrait.description: Trait rendered inside the app layout content area
contentTrait.label: Content trait

currentPath.description: Nav-highlight ONLY: which nav item to mark active. This is NOT the page route — it does not change what page loads or where the orbital lives. To set the landing route or a page path, use the orbital's pagePath / page path, not this knob. When omitted, the layout reads the current route.
currentPath.label: Current path
currentPath.synonyms: active nav item, highlighted nav link, which menu item is selected, nav highlight

layoutMode.description: sidebar = left rail; topnav = top bar; bottomnav = mobile tab bar; minimal = no nav.
layoutMode.label: Where should navigation be placed?
layoutMode.synonyms: nav position, navigation style, menu placement, layout style

layoutPattern.description: UI pattern used to render the application chrome
layoutPattern.label: Layout pattern

navItems.description: Top-level navigation links shown on the left rail.
navItems.label: Which sections appear in the sidebar?
navItems.synonyms: nav links, menu items, sidebar sections, navigation entries, pages

notificationClickEvent.description: Event emitted when the user picks a notification
notificationClickEvent.label: Notification click event

notifications.description: Items shown in the notifications dropdown.
notifications.label: What notifications should appear?
notifications.synonyms: alerts, messages, notices, notification items, bell items

searchEvent.description: Event emitted when the user runs a global search
searchEvent.label: Search event

sidebarTrait.description: Optional trait rendered in the sidebar between the nav links and the footer — the Notion/Confluence-style always-visible page tree; scrolls independently. Unset renders plain nav only.
sidebarTrait.label: Sidebar trait
sidebarTrait.synonyms: sidebar tree, nav tree, page tree in sidebar, hierarchy rail

theme.description: Data-theme attribute applied to the layout root (e.g. almadar-website-dark).
theme.label: Theme

topBarActions.description: Icon buttons shown on the right side of the top bar (e.g. cart, help, profile).
topBarActions.label: What shortcuts go in the top bar?
topBarActions.synonyms: toolbar buttons, header actions, shortcut icons, quick actions

viewerAvatar.description: Avatar image URL for the account menu.
viewerAvatar.label: Signed-in avatar

viewerEmail.description: Email shown under the name in the account menu — typically @user.email.
viewerEmail.label: Signed-in email

viewerName.description: Display name of the signed-in viewer, shown in the app bar's account menu — typically @user.name. Blank renders no account menu, so people can see which account (and which persona) they are viewing the app as only when it is actually known.
viewerName.label: Who is signed in
viewerName.synonyms: signed in user, current user, account, profile, persona, who am i
